definitions.explanation: The feeling of sadness and reluctance when saying goodbye to someone. A literary and formal word.

examples.english: I felt the sadness of parting.
A farewell gathering for our mentor was held.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホーム→ホーム：00113_hoomu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{惜別|せきべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}し→流す：01968_nagasu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見送|みおく}った→見送る：04240_miokuru⟧。
examples.english: I saw my friend off at the station platform, shedding tears of reluctant farewell.

notes:
A literary word expressing sorrow at parting. Composed of {惜|せき} (to regret, to feel reluctant) + ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (separation). Used in formal writing, speeches, and literary contexts rather than everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {惜別|せきべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧: feelings of reluctant parting
- {惜別|せきべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧: tears of farewell
- {惜別|せきべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情|じょう}→情：03343_jou⟧: sentiments of parting
- {惜別|せきべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧: farewell gathering
- {惜別|せきべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{辞|じ}: farewell words

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{別|わか}れ→別れ：03788_wakare⟧: parting, farewell — the most common everyday word
- ⟦{送別|そうべつ}→送別：04391_soubetsu⟧: seeing someone off, farewell — focuses on the act of sending off (⟦{送別会|そうべつかい}→送別会：16080_soubetsukai⟧: farewell party)
- ⟦{離別|りべつ}→離別：21514_ribetsu⟧: separation, parting — more neutral; can imply permanent separation
- {告別|こくべつ}: formal farewell — often used for funerals (⟦{告別式|こくべつしき}→告別式：05923_kokubetsushiki⟧: funeral ceremony)

REGISTER:
This is a literary and formal word. In everyday speech, ⟦{別|わか}れ→別れ：03788_wakare⟧ or ⟦{別|わか}れ→別れ：03788_wakare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{惜|お}しむ→惜しむ：09610_oshimu⟧ (to be reluctant to part) is more natural.
